manifest.title: Ambient motion on the Giza plateau against the radar floor

params.roads: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API; data under the Open Database License (ODbL), www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
params.worst_case: a vehicle on every road at its point nearest each spot; held at the 15 m level within 15 m

finding: Even with a truck on every road at its nearest point, ambient motion reaches the radar's 77 um/s floor only within 25 m of a road, and only for a truck over a bump (17% of the plateau); a typical truck never does. Khafre's centre is 199 m from the nearest mapped road; the microseisms are 1,571 times below the floor everywhere.
